Network Segmentation Diameter

Emergency protocol SEVERA is initiated. A large inter-galactic relay tree with N nodes must be partitioned into exactly two independent subtrees by permanently severing exactly one relay link. After any such severance, each remaining subtree's relay span (diameter â€” the maximum distance between any two nodes within the subtree) is computed.

You must choose the single link to sever so that the maximum relay span across both resulting subtrees is minimized. Output this optimal minimum of the maximum relay span.
explanation: For each edge (u, v) in the tree, removing it splits the tree into two subtrees. For each candidate split, compute the diameter of both resulting subtrees using two BFS calls each (BFS to find the farthest node, then BFS again to find the diameter). The answer is the minimum across all edges of the maximum of the two subtree diameters. Brute force: O(N^2) â€” for large N use rerooting DP to compute subtree diameters in O(N).
